scope: Johnson County, Indiana online continuing education and professional skill development

records.name: Johnson County Public Library Gale Courses
records.description: Provides free, instructor-led six-week online courses for Johnson County Public Library cardholders, with new sessions beginning monthly. Topics include business, accounting, finance, law, technology, Microsoft applications, web design, computer programming, and personal enrichment.
records.availability_notes: Free access requires a valid Johnson County Public Library card. Courses run for six weeks, new sessions begin monthly, and current course offerings and enrollment dates should be checked before recommendation. Verified August 6, 2026.
